name: Masdenverge (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with a white farmhouse (mas) between two yellow olive branches with black olives.
history: The official flag of Masdenverge is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green with the white mas of the arms, 9/20 of the height and 8/15 of the length of the cloth, at the centre, and the two yellow olive branches; approved on 5 February 2004 and published in the DOGC on 1 March 2004, based on the arms of the town.

features.role: two olive branches flanking the house
